campaigns.name: KAPIME
campaigns.subtitle: Hepatitis Awareness & Prevention
campaigns.description: Kapime means 'Get Tested' in Swahili. This flagship initiative raises awareness about Hepatitis B, encourages vaccination, and connects communities to testing and care.
campaigns.whatIs: A comprehensive hepatitis screening and vaccination campaign designed to eliminate viral hepatitis by 2030.
campaigns.whyMatters: Viral hepatitis is a silent epidemic in Tanzania, with thousands unaware of their infection status. Without early detection and treatment, it can lead to liver cancer and cirrhosis.
howWorks: Community awareness sessions via radio and public forums
Training health ambassadors in local communities
Mobile testing units visiting underserved areas
Vaccination programs in partnership with healthcare providers
activities2025: World Hepatitis Day media engagement (radio broadcast)
Community health marathon for hepatitis awareness
Hepatitis education outreach in schools & universities
impact2025: 500+ individuals reached at World Hepatitis Day

testimonial.quote: Getting tested through KAPIME saved my life. I discovered my hepatitis B status early and started treatment immediately.
testimonial.name: Fatima M.

campaigns.name: Life Unlocked
campaigns.subtitle: Mental Health for Youth Transitions
campaigns.description: Supporting young Tanzanians through mental health awareness, resilience-building, life skills, and peer support, especially during the challenging post-college period.
campaigns.whatIs: A youth-focused mental health initiative providing counseling, life skills training, and peer support communities.
campaigns.whyMatters: Mental health challenges are growing among young Tanzanians, with inadequate resources and high stigma preventing people from seeking help.
howWorks: Mental health awareness workshops in schools and universities
Youth clubs providing peer support and life skills training
One-on-one counseling with trained mental health professionals
activities2025: Mental health awareness sessions at City College (main campus)
Mental health outreach at Temeke Secondary School
impact2025: Increased youth awareness on mental health
Improved mental health understanding among students

testimonial.quote: Life Unlocked gave me tools to manage my anxiety and connect with others facing similar challenges. I don't feel alone anymore.
testimonial.name: Hassan K.

campaigns.name: Talk To Heal
campaigns.subtitle: Mental Health Conversations & Support
campaigns.description: Creating safe, stigma-free spaces for mental health conversations. Talk To Heal connects individuals with mental health professionals and trained peer supporters.
campaigns.whatIs: A community-based mental health support network offering counseling, dialogue circles, and peer support.
campaigns.whyMatters: Mental health stigma prevents many Tanzanians from seeking help. Peer support creates safe spaces where people feel understood and not judged.
howWorks: Community dialogue circles for mental health discussion
Trained peer supporters offering confidential support
Connection to professional mental health counselors
activities2025: 2 community engagement events on mental health
Mental health awareness programs for communities
impact2025: Increased community participation in health programs
Improved mental health conversations in communities

testimonial.quote: Talk To Heal saved me from dark thoughts. Having someone listen without judgment made all the difference.
testimonial.name: Amina S.
